info.description: Retrieve Hong Kong external merchandise trade statistics as JSON. API usage is subject to limits that may be adjusted without prior notice. Authentication requirements are not specified. The version value is a metadata placeholder, not a publisher API version.
info.title: Trade-Interactive Data Dissemination Service (Trade-IDDS) API

get.description: The publisher documents a GET data request and a JSON response. Parameters and values are case-insensitive. The `period` range is inclusive; annual values use YYYY and monthly values use YYYYMM. The response includes textual descriptions in the selected language. Nil/default or unspecified values are documented for several optional selectors. Usage limits may be adjusted without prior notice. See the official documentation for Annex 1 origin and consignment codes and Annex 2 commodity classification references.

parameters.description: Language for descriptions in the data response.
parameters.name: lang

parameters.description: Statistics selection; multiple values are allowed. Returned with a textual description in `svDsecXX` and unit in `unitXX`; the value is in `figure`.
parameters.name: sv

parameters.description: Inclusive period range. For annual frequency use `YYYY,YYYY` (for example, `2015,2017`); for monthly frequency use `YYYYMM,YYYYMM` (for example, `201701,201712`).
parameters.name: period

parameters.description: Trade type. The publisher also documents `ALL` as a value.
parameters.name: ttype

parameters.description: Transport mode. Nil (default or unspecified) is documented; `Y` means Yes. The response description uses `tmDsecXX`.
parameters.name: tm

parameters.description: Origin class. Nil (default or unspecified) is documented. `R` selects Region and `C` selects Country/Territory; when `co` is supplied, this class determines the applicable code set.
parameters.name: coclass

parameters.description: Origin codes; multiple values are allowed. Nil (default or unspecified) is documented. Region selections allow at most 1 code; Country/Territory selections allow at most 30. `ALL` is shown for all origins. See Annex 1 for codes. Response descriptions use `coRegionDsecXX` for regions and `coDsecXX` for Country/Territory.
parameters.name: co

parameters.description: Consignment class. Nil (default or unspecified) is documented. `R` selects Region and `C` selects Country/Territory; when `cc` is supplied, this class determines the applicable code set.
parameters.name: ccclass

parameters.description: Consignment codes; multiple values are allowed. Nil (default or unspecified) is documented. Region selections allow at most 1 code; Country/Territory selections allow at most 30. See Annex 1 for codes. Response descriptions use `ccRegionDsecXX` for regions and `ccDsecXX` for Country/Territory.
parameters.name: cc

parameters.description: Commodity classification. Nil (default or unspecified) is documented. Select a classification and level: HKHS, HKHS2, HKHS4, HKHS6, HKHS8, SITC, SITC1, SITC2, SITC3, SITC5, or EUC (End-Use Category). Annex 2 links to classification references.
parameters.name: codeclass

parameters.description: Commodity codes; multiple values are allowed, with a maximum of 20. Nil (default or unspecified) is documented. For HKHS and SITC consult Annex 2; for EUC the publisher says codes need not be specified. Response descriptions use `codeDsecXX`.
parameters.name: code

tablenote: The exported JSON is mainly used for data exchange, please read the corresponding footnote in the original statistical table.

Adjustments relating to earlier months of a particular year are incorporated in the cumulative totals of that year only. It follows that the sums of the monthly figures may differ from the cumulative totals.

Hong Kong's external merchandise trade statistics are compiled based on information contained in import/export declarations. The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is a separate customs territory, as stated in "The Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China". Import/export declaration is also required of Hong Kong's merchandise trade with Chinese Mainland, and statistics relating to this are included in Hong Kong's external merchandise trade statistics.
Figures may not add up to total due to rounding.
Countries of consignment with nil records is omitted.
header.title: Total exports by Selected Destinations, May 2018 - Jun 2018

200.description: JSON data response. The body status reports query success or an error condition; the documentation does not specify HTTP status mappings for those status codes.
